import json, subprocess, time, urllib.request, asyncio, websockets, os, signal
html='file:///tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5.6-luna-high-clean-olV3yX/dashboard.html'
proc=subprocess.Popen(['google-chrome','--headless','--no-sandbox','--disable-gpu','--remote-debugging-port=9222','--user-data-dir=/tmp/market-lens-cdp','about:blank'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
try:
    tab=None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            tabs=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:9222/json'))
            if tabs:
                tab=tabs[0]; break
        except Exception: time.sleep(.1)
    if not tab: raise RuntimeError('Chrome CDP tab unavailable')
    async def run():
        async with websockets.connect(tab['webSocketDebuggerUrl']) as ws:
            seq=0
            async def cmd(method, params=None):
                nonlocal seq
                seq+=1; await ws.send(json.dumps({'id':seq,'method':method,'params':params or {}}))
                while True:
                    msg=json.loads(await ws.recv())
                    if msg.get('id')==seq: return msg
            await cmd('Page.navigate',{'url':html})
            await asyncio.sleep(.7)
            def eval_js(expr): return cmd('Runtime.evaluate',{'expression':expr,'returnByValue':True})
            initial=await eval_js(\"({price:document.querySelector('#heroPrice').textContent, base:document.querySelector('#baseMetric').textContent, paths:document.querySelectorAll('#chart polyline').length})\")
            await eval_js(\"document.querySelector('[data-horizon=\\\\\\\"12\\\\\\\"]').click()\")
            await asyncio.sleep(.1)
            horizon=await eval_js(\"document.querySelector('#chartSubtitle').textContent\")
            await eval_js(\"document.querySelector('#modelSelect').value='trend'; document.querySelector('#modelSelect').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))\")
            await asyncio.sleep(.1)
            trend=await eval_js(\"({base:document.querySelector('#baseMetric').textContent, model:document.querySelector('#chartSubtitle').textContent})\")
            await eval_js(\"document.querySelector('#lookbackSelect').value='60'; document.querySelector('#lookbackSelect').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))\")
            await asyncio.sleep(.1)
            lookback=await eval_js(\"document.querySelector('#chartSubtitle').textContent\")
            return initial,horizon,trend,lookback
    initial,horizon,trend,lookback=asyncio.run(run())
    print('Initial render:',initial['result']['result']['value'])
    print('Horizon interaction:',horizon['result']['result']['value'])
    print('Model interaction:',trend['result']['result']['value'])
    print('Lookback interaction:',lookback['result']['result']['value'])
    print('CDP smoke: OK')
finally:
    proc.terminate()
    try: proc.wait(timeout=3)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: proc.kill()
PY"
